g1.necessity: The Deepin 0.6.54 outbound privacy final guard treated documentation-only a private-key start delimiter text in historical reasoning_content as a real secret, although transport redaction only recognizes complete PEM containers. This deterministic false positive prevented safe continuation of an otherwise redacted session; alignment is necessary without weakening true secret protection.

g2.authority_owner: Existing cache_guard outbound_privacy.py and guard.py final check with security_guard.redact_secrets_for_transport; no new controller, policy authority, or bypass.
g2.non_duplication: The patch reuses the existing transport redaction patterns as the final residual detection source and preserves protected structural-field and key-name fail-closed checks; it does not add a competing allowlist or alternate Provider path.

model_evidence: Synthetic positive/negative privacy projection unit tests (including historical reasoning_content bare marker).
Deepin 0.6.54 read-only offline 717-message projection: old rule BLOCK, aligned rule ALLOW with 3 redactions, provider not called.
Host independent DeepSeek-v4-flash Reviewer PASS on original privacy patch 79737f19b; fresh combined SHA still requires its own verdict.
g3.recovery_or_reason: When a real credential appears in ordinary content, redact it before Provider send; when a protected signature/identifier or secret dict key is not safely transformable, deny with a nonsecret reason. On redactor failure deny and do not log raw values; for benign bare markers allow after the same final transport pattern check.

g4.rollback: Keep current immutable Deepin 0.6.54 wheel and its deployment generation until a separate 0.6.55 artifact passes all gates. Managed rollback restores prior wheel; no user session or evidence migration is part of this change.
